start_with: Confirm the request exists and inspect its type, opportunity, campus, state, status, and assigned connector.
Check whether the connector is looking at My Requests, All Requests, My Types, or My Opportunities.
Clear or deliberately set campus, opportunity, state, and status filters.
Check security at the request, opportunity, and type levels.
If campaign-generated, confirm connector-group membership and campus compatibility.
Inspect the installed patch level if opportunity counts or navigation visibility disagree with permissions; v19.3 includes a related fix.
Stop when the request is visible under the intended identity and scope, or when a specific security/configuration mismatch has been isolated.
branches.title: A connector cannot see an expected request
branches.when: A connector cannot see an expected request

start_with: Confirm Rock v19 and the exact block being used.
Inspect the connection type's enabled views.
Open List settings and inspect selected columns, grouping, and sorting.
Confirm request sources are configured if the source field is expected.
Verify opportunity and campus filters.
Compare behavior using an authorized administrator and the affected connector.
Stop when the missing element is explained by version, block settings, source configuration, or security.
branches.title: A list field, source, grouping option, or view is missing
branches.when: A list field, source, grouping option, or view is missing

do_not_assume: Stop when the blocking lifecycle or placement requirement is identified; do not bypass it through an unrelated state change.
start_with: Inspect whether sequential status mode is enabled.
Verify configured status order and the request's current status.
Move through the next adjacent status if sequential mode is intentional.
Confirm the request has reached the final status before completion.
Inspect whether a placement group, group requirement, or completion note is required.
Verify the intended placement group, role, and member status.
Stop when the blocking lifecycle or placement requirement is identified; do not bypass it through an unrelated state change.
branches.title: A request cannot skip to a later status or cannot be completed
branches.when: A request cannot skip to a later status or cannot be completed

start_with: Confirm the metric's campus, type, and opportunity scope.
Inspect the connection type's due-date calculation mode.
Check opportunity- and status-level due-date or due-soon offsets.
Confirm whether the request has a calculated due date.
Separate active requests from Future Follow-up, inactive, and completed requests.
Open a small sample of underlying requests and reproduce the expected calculation.
Stop when the discrepancy is explained or a version-specific defect is reproducible.
branches.title: Due-soon or overdue counts look wrong
branches.when: Due-soon or overdue counts look wrong

start_with: Confirm the request is in Future Follow-up state.
Inspect the stored follow-up date.
Confirm the date has passed in the installation's effective time context.
Inspect the Connection Request Workflow Triggers job's schedule and recent results.
Check whether another workflow or status rule changed the request after deferral.
Re-open the request without restrictive list filters.
Stop when the job, date, state, or filter condition explains the behavior.
branches.title: A future follow-up request did not return to the active queue
branches.when: A future follow-up request did not return to the active queue

start_with: Confirm the campaign is active and points to the intended opportunity.
Validate the source Data View with a bounded sample.
Inspect family limits and opt-out-group membership.
Confirm whether creation is All at Once or As Needed.
Check the daily limit; zero or blank prevents automatic creation and assignment.
Inspect the campaign-processing job and its recent result.
Confirm connectors belong to the configured group and match campus rules.
Inspect per-connector daily-limit and schedule-day overrides.
branches.title: A campaign creates no requests or assigns them to the wrong people
branches.when: A campaign creates no requests or assigns them to the wrong people

start_with: Identify whether the workflow is configured on the type or opportunity.
Verify the trigger matches the event; bulk launch requires a Manual trigger.
Confirm any status, age-classification, or Data View applicability filter.
For Activity Added, verify the workflow expects an activity rather than a request.
Read the bulk-action result count and inspect excluded requests.
Check workflow persistence and workflow history.
Inspect the Rock patch level for known workflow-related fixes.
Stop when applicability, trigger configuration, input entity, permissions, or execution history explains the outcome.
branches.title: A workflow did not launch or a bulk action affected only some requests
branches.when: A workflow did not launch or a bulk action affected only some requests

do_not_assume: Stop if provider access, prompt configuration, or evidence quality is insufficient; do not copy unverified generated statements into authoritative person data.
start_with: Confirm the installed version and that the feature exists in the active request block.
Inspect the connection type's AI-summary settings.
Confirm a prompt is configured.
Confirm an AI provider is configured and available.
Check whether generation is manual or automatic.
Verify the current user's access to the request and AI surface.
Compare generated claims with request activities and governed person data.
Stop if provider access, prompt configuration, or evidence quality is insufficient; do not copy unverified generated statements into authoritative person data.
branches.title: An AI summary is unavailable or unreliable
branches.when: An AI summary is unavailable or unreliable
